description: This file defines the NewsCategory class, which models a news category containing a collection of NewsArticle objects. It includes methods for creating a category with a set number of articles, retrieving the count of articles, and accessing individual articles.

classes.name: NewsCategory
classes.description: Represents a news category containing multiple news articles. It initializes articles using a generator and provides access methods.

methods.name: NewsCategory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the articles array with newly generated NewsArticle instances.

methods.name: getArticleCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of articles in this category.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Returns the NewsArticle at the specified index.
